Name: FNS Vigorous Running
Author: FinFNS
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#3d85c6]FNS Vigorous Running[/color]
[/b][/size][b][size=5]
Run faster. Run farther. Just don't run forever.[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=5][youtube]Cegk926zTrs[/youtube][/size][/b][/center]

[size=4]FNS Vigorous Running adds a configurable sprinting system to Stardew Valley powered by a new [b]Vigor[/b] resource bar. Sprinting gives you a substantial movement-speed boost while draining Vigor, which regenerates when you stop running.[/size]
[size=4]
Designed especially for larger modded worlds where getting from one side of the valley to the other can become a hike.[/size]
[line]
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]🏃 [b]Toggleable sprinting[/b] with a configurable hotkey[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]⚡ [b]Separate Vigor resource[/b] for sprinting[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]📊 [b]Dedicated Vigor HUD bar[/b] beside Health and Energy[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]🚀 [b]Low, Medium, and High sprint speeds[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4]☕ [b]Stacks with normal movement-speed buffs[/b], including food and drinks[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]🐎 [b]Works while mounted (by default)[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4]🔋 [b]Dynamic Energy scaling[/b] ties sprint performance to your current vanilla Energy[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]😴 [b]Vigor recalibrates after sleeping[/b] based on your Energy the following morning[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]⏸️ Respects normal single-player pausing[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]⚙️ Fully configurable through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][heading][line]
Default Settings[/heading]
[size=4]The defaults are intended to provide a noticeable speed increase without turning your farmer into a rocket.
[b]Sprint Key:[/b] Left Ctrl
[b]Sprint Mode:[/b] Toggle
[b]Sprint Speed:[/b] Medium
[b]Maximum Vigor:[/b] 100
[b]Vigor Drain:[/b] 3.33/sec
[b]Vigor Regeneration:[/b] 5/sec
[b]Regeneration Delay:[/b] 1.5 seconds
[b]Dynamic Energy Scaling:[/b] Enabled
[b]Disable When Exhausted:[/b] Enabled
[b]Allow While Mounted:[/b] Enabled
Nearly everything can be adjusted through GMCM.[/size]
[heading][line]
Requirements[/heading]
[size=4][b]Required:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]SMAPI[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]GMCM is intentionally required so players can easily configure Vigorous Running from Stardew Valley's in-game Mods menu.[/size]
[line]
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[size=4]Vigorous Running is designed to play nicely with vanilla movement bonuses. Spicy Eel, Coffee, Triple Shot Espresso, and other movement-speed effects can stack with your sprint rather than being replaced by it.[/size]
[size=4]
The mod also supports sprinting while riding a horse when [b]Allow While Mounted[/b] is enabled (which it is by default).

This mod dhould be compatible with everything excluding other mods that add/effect running/speed. I would not add other running/sprinting mods on top of this one.[/size]

[size=4]I did test it against my Wabbajack MO2 Mod List: Potluck with about 400 other mods and it worked fine.

If playing with a mod that adds another Bar next to Health and Energy (like a Mana bar), you can adjust where the Vigor Bar is placed in the GMCM in-game mods menu.

In time, I will add compatibility with other UI/HUD recolor mods like Earthy Recolor UI.[/size]
[line]
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[size=4]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b], then install [b]FNS Vigorous Running[/b] like any other SMAPI mod.[/size]
[size=4]
Launch the game through SMAPI and configure the mod through the in-game Mods menu.[/size]

[line]
[heading]Why do we need [i]another[/i] Sprint mod?[/heading]
[size=4]Other mods that added sprinting, adjusted movement speed, or overhauled movement didn't do it for me. They either trivialized food/horses, had regenerating Energy, didn't go fast enough, felt like cheating by going too fast, allowed you to run forever, or were tied to the Energy bar. I wanted [/size][size=4]a balanced way to move faster that didn't eliminate the value of coffee/horses, and didn't want it to touch the Energy bar. So I created the Vigor bar. [/size]

[size=4]Modded Stardew Valley can get [b]big[/b]. [/size]

[size=4]With expanded maps, additional locations, new farms, and other world-expansion mods, normal walking speed can make traveling feel unnecessarily slow. Vigorous Running provides faster traversal while retaining a resource-management mechanic instead of simply giving the player permanent super speed.

Or set Sprint Speed to [b]High[/b] and run like you have somewhere important to be. 🏃💨[/size]
[line]
[size=5][b]Work in Progress:[/b][/size]

[size=4]I have not tested this mod in Multiplayer. If one of you can have multiple players test this, please let me know if it works. [/size]

[size=4]I did my best to stress test this mod in various in-game scenarios, but it's possible I didn't account for everything. If you notice something I missed, post a comment describing the issue.[/size]

[size=4]Ditto if you have suggestions to improve the mod (aside from what's listed in the next section). [/size]

[line]
[b][size=5]Future Plans:[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4]Fix the ugly looking Vigor bar. If another modder wants to help, that would be great![/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Add compatibility with other UI/HUD recolor mods like Earthy Recolor UI. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Consider other uses for Vigor. Maybe add a Vigorous Combat mod with special attacks.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]If any other mod authors reading this would like to work with me, or tap into the Vigor bar for their own mods, I'd be happy to work with you and provide the Vigorous Running source files.[/size]
